$comment: kgf's OWN MCP server registry (ADR-9). Not a Claude Code registration:
nothing here is written to ~/.claude/settings.json, and kgf never writes
any client's settings file. `kgf mcp config` prints a launch block on
stdout and whoever runs it decides where it goes.
Paths are resolved from the INSTALLED package location, not from a
workspace root, so this registry survives an install outside the repo.
Posture (sandbox root, allow_bash, allow_network) is NOT here. It lives
in ~/.kgf/mcp.json, because a registry is shared and a posture is local.
